pageTitle: South Carolina Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: Will I Pay Taxes on My South Carolina Lottery Winnings?
items.answer: Yes. All lottery winnings in South Carolina are subject to state and federal taxes. Furthermore, the South Carolina Lottery must withhold a specific percentage of all winnings for tax purposes.

items.question: What Should I Do If I’m One of the South Carolina Lottery Winners?
items.answer:
Most importantly, sign the back of your winning ticket to validate yourself as the rightful owner. If you win less than $500, you can redeem your prize at any authorized retailer.

Alternatively, you can mail or personally deliver your ticket to the Official Lottery Office in Columbia. Postal Address is SC Educational Lottery, PO Box 11039, Columbia. SC 29211-1039

items.question: How to Play the South Carolina Lottery & Can I Buy Tickets Online or Over the Phone?
items.answer: You can buy your lottery tickets from any of the licensed participating retailers. However, you can’t sell or purchase lottery tickets over the phone, email, or online.

items.question: How Old Must I Be to Buy a South Carolina Lottery Ticket?
items.answer: The legal age to participate in the South Carolina Lottery is 18.

items.question: If I Have South Carolina Lottery Winning Numbers, How Long Do I Have to Claim My Prize?
items.answer: You have 180 days to claim your prize from the day the South Carolina Lottery results are determined.

items.question: Where Can I Find the Results of the South Carolina Lottery?
items.answer: All authorized retailers will have the winning numbers available. You can also download the South Carolina Lottery app for Android and iOS for instant results of all the draws.

items.question: I Lost/Damaged My Winning Ticket. What Must I Do?
items.answer: You are solely responsible for keeping your lottery ticket safe. The South Carolina Lottery can not be held liable for lost or damaged cards.

items.question: How Many Games Can I Play in the South Carolina Lottery & When Are the Draws?
items.answer:
Instant daily wins with the South Carolina Lottery scratch tickets

items.question: Is There a South Carolina Lottery Second Chance Game?
items.answer: Yes. It offers three second-chance games: Million Dollar Mega Multiplier, Game of Suits, and Cleansweep.

items.question: What Are the Other Numbers on the Bottom of My Instant Tickets?
items.answer: These are South Carolina Lottery codes used to verify winning tickets in cases where the South Carolina Lottery ticket scanners are out of order.

items.question: May I Remain Anonymous If I Win the South Carolina Lottery Jackpot?
items.answer: Yes! Fortunately, South Carolina falls under the few states where it is still allowed legally.

items.question: Can I Buy Multiple Draw Tickets in Advance for the South Carolina Lottery?
items.answer: Yes. You can purchase tickets for advance draws for all the games.
